reporter.headline: Simulated Planet Nine at V 13.0: not recovered
reporter.dossier_md:
This is a synthetic planet from the Caltech reference population, injected into real SPHEREx frames along its true parallax track at 225 AU. It is invisible in any single frame (best single-frame SNR 35.5) and reaches SNR 3.2 when the frames are shifted along the correct trial motion and stacked.

The search did not reach it. Failures like this one set the completeness limit shown on the Proof page. 

Nothing about this object is real. It exists to calibrate the search and to train the classifier and the crowd.

sources: NASA SPHEREx DR1 Level 2 spectral images via IRSA (irsa.ipac.caltech.edu)
